notes.title: Astral Savior X Astral Survivor X Cupid Bistro MAX Collaboration for July 8
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45644884/3b359d04bd8da5734957edef8055fb326f0078fc.jpg"][/img]Astral Savior X Astral Survivor X Cupid Bistro MAX Collaboration Confirmed for July 8![/p][p]In this dream crossover, the ultra-popular character Lavender from Cupid Bistro MAX makes a stunning debut as an event-exclusive character! Her unique charm and powerful skills will add endless possibilities to your adventure! Join the limited-time event to unlock Lavender’s exclusive storyline and rewards, and experience the epic tale woven across three games! The event runs for a limited time starting July 8—don’t miss out!

"Cupid Bistro MAX" is a simulation game blending romance, restaurant management, and RPG elements, available on Steam since March 9, 2020.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1249980/MAX/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Astral Savior – Version 1.0.104 Update
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Astral Savior – Version 1.0.104 Update[/b][/h3][hr][/hr][p][b]🔧 Fixes & Improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Power Up were not applied properly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed certain UI texts not displaying correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed character demo videos not playing[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the upgrade interface during battle[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]📌 About the Power Up save issue:[/b]
We discovered that starting a New Game could sometimes cause save data issues, leading to Power Ups not being saved or reset.[/p][p]This bug has been fixed in this update.
If you were affected, all previously spent upgrade gold has been [b]refunded based on your save record[/b].[/p][p]Please [b]update the game and relaunch[/b] to confirm.[/p][p]We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience,
and thank you for your continued support of [b]Astral Savior[/b]![/p]
